tracks.title: Quantitative Foundations
tracks.description: Core mathematical and statistical tools every quant researcher needs.

topics.title: Probability
topics.description: Combinatorics, conditional probability, Bayes' theorem, distributions, expectation, limit theorems.

topics.title: Statistics
topics.description: Estimation, hypothesis testing, confidence intervals, Bayesian inference.

topics.title: Linear Algebra
topics.description: Vector spaces, eigenvalues, SVD, PCA, matrix decompositions.

topics.title: Linear Regression
topics.description: OLS, regularization, model selection, practical applications in alpha research.

topics.title: Time Series
topics.description: Stationarity, AR/MA/ARIMA, GARCH, cointegration, Kalman filtering.

topics.title: Stochastic Calculus
topics.description: Brownian motion, Ito's lemma, SDEs, martingales, Girsanov's theorem.

topics.title: Optimization
topics.description: Convex optimization, Lagrange multipliers, KKT conditions, gradient descent.

topics.title: Portfolio Construction
topics.description: Mean-variance framework, factor models, risk budgeting, rebalancing.

topics.title: Portfolio Optimization
topics.description: Markowitz, Black-Litterman, robust optimization, transaction costs.

topics.title: Numerical Methods
topics.description: Monte Carlo, finite differences, numerical integration, root finding.

tracks.title: Finance & Markets
tracks.description: Financial instruments, pricing models, risk, and trading.

topics.title: Fixed Income & Bonds
topics.description: Bond pricing, yields, duration, convexity, term structure, credit risk.

topics.title: Options & Derivatives
topics.description: Payoff diagrams, put-call parity, binomial model, exotic options.

topics.title: Volatility Modeling
topics.description: Implied vs realized vol, vol surface, local vol, stochastic vol, SABR.

topics.title: Black-Scholes & Greeks
topics.description: BS derivation, delta, gamma, vega, theta, hedging strategies.

topics.title: Risk Modeling
topics.description: VaR, Expected Shortfall, stress testing, factor-based risk models.

topics.title: Risk Management
topics.description: Position sizing, stop-loss, correlation, tail risk, liquidity risk.

topics.title: Market Microstructure
topics.description: Order books, bid-ask spread, market making, price impact models.

topics.title: Trading Strategies
topics.description: Statistical arbitrage, momentum, mean reversion, pairs trading, backtesting.
